SEARCH_TARGET: the historical producer/builder capable of creating stageA_input.duckdb, or a semantically equivalent stage-A bars surface
SEARCH_UNIVERSE: 1. backend/ — all tracked and untracked readable source/config/script files
3. all MASSIVE_1M_* / MASSIVE_15M_* sealed JSON artifacts, including superseded/dead-path metadata where readable
4. repository history if locally available — filenames, deleted/renamed paths, commit contents relevant to stageA / ingest / aggregate / coverage
6. surviving scratchpad metadata — RECOVERY EVIDENCE ONLY, never authority

SCHEMA_SIGNATURE_SEARCH.rule: the builder may not be NAMED stageA. A CONJUNCTION of coverage_state + interval_index + bar_start co-occurring in one file is stronger evidence than any filename match.

COMMAND_STATUS_DISCIPLINE.rule: every search command's exit status is verified
COMMAND_STATUS_DISCIPLINE.grep_semantics: exit 0 = matches, exit 1 = NO MATCHES (valid negative), exit >=2 = ERROR
COMMAND_STATUS_DISCIPLINE.FORBIDDEN: interpreting a FAILED command as '0 matches'

REQUIRED_SEAL_CONTENT: ENUMERATION: directories/files considered, readable, skipped, permission failures, parse/read failures
COMMAND STATUS: every command's exit status
RESULTS: candidates found / inspected / unresolved (must be 0)
SCHEMA INSPECTION: all plausible candidates OPENED and inspected, not merely grep-counted
INCOMPLETENESS_RULE: if ANY enumerated directory is inaccessible or ANY candidate is left uninspected, the verdict is SEARCH_INCOMPLETE. A negative claim is NOT authorized.

IF_FOUND.required: historical replay of a sample must reproduce the existing table EXACTLY: interval_index, session_date, bar_start, OHLCV, coverage_state
boundary_fixtures: ticker rename with the same security_key
IF_FOUND.then: A1 = forward INSTANTIATION of the historical producer, not reconstruction

IF_NOT_FOUND.coverage_state: a dictionary of observed values is NOT sufficient. The INPUT PATTERN that produces each state must be DEMONSTRATED from the existing table — e.g. 14 of 15 minutes present may NOT be assumed to be PARTIAL.
IF_NOT_FOUND.interval_index: must be recovered with SESSION-RELATIVE semantics, not assumed clock arithmetic; early close and DST/session-calendar boundaries get their own fixtures

A1_STATUS: BLOCKED until (BUILDER_FOUND_AND_QUALIFIED) OR (NEGATIVE_SEARCH_WITH_ENUMERATION complete + reconstructed StageA contract frozen + boundary/equivalence qualification PASS)
SCOPE: engineering recovery only — touches no part of the frozen forward design
